chapter_name: A Letter to God and Poems
learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the power of unbreakable faith, the irony of situations, and how nature can both heal (Dust of Snow) and destroy (Fire and Ice).

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Lencho, a hardworking farmer, loses his entire crop to a hailstorm. Having absolute faith in God, he writes a letter asking for 100 pesos. The postmaster, an amiable man, collects 70 pesos from his employees and sends it to Lencho. Ironically, Lencho gets angry, thinking the post office employees stole the remaining 30 pesos, and calls them a 'bunch of crooks'.

main_concepts.concept_title: ❄️ Dust of Snow (Poem by Robert Frost)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: The poet is in a depressed mood. A crow shakes a poisonous Hemlock tree, and fine snow dust falls on the poet. This sudden, small, beautiful act of nature instantly changes his sad mood and saves the rest of his day. It shows that even negative things (crow, hemlock) can bring joy.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🔥 Fire and Ice (Poem by Robert Frost)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: The poet discusses two ways the world will end. 'Fire' symbolizes human desires, greed, and lust. 'Ice' symbolizes cold hatred, cruelty, and insensitivity. He says desire (fire) is enough to destroy the world, but if it had to perish twice, hatred (ice) is equally powerful and destructive.

fun_activity.title: ✉️ The Irony of the Letter
fun_activity.instructions: Irony is when the exact opposite of what you expect happens. The post office workers did a very noble deed by giving up their own salary to help Lencho. But what did they get in return? Lencho called them thieves (crooks)! That is the ultimate situational irony. Can you think of a time when you tried to help someone but got scolded instead?

exam_tips: 📌 Character sketch of Lencho (innocent, hardworking, blind faith) and the Postmaster (kind, empathetic, helpful) are very frequently asked.
📌 In 'Dust of Snow', remember what the Crow and Hemlock represent: they are usually symbols of sorrow and death, but Frost uses them positively to heal his mood.
📌 In 'Fire and Ice', clearly map the metaphors: Fire = Desire/Greed; Ice = Hatred/Coldness.
quick_recap: ⭐ Lencho asked for 100 pesos but received only 70 pesos.
⭐ Robert Frost is the poet of both 'Dust of Snow' and 'Fire and Ice'.
⭐ The central theme of Chapter 1 is that extreme faith in God is pure, but humans often lack faith in each other.
